title: New non-Euclidean neural quantum states from hyperbolic Lorentz recurrent architectures
summary: In this work, we construct new non-Euclidean neural quantum states (NQS) based on hyperbolic Lorentz recurrent architectures (RNN/GRU). These constructions, together with the Poincare RNN NQS also newly constructed here, extend the class of previously introduced non-Eucllidean NQS which consists only of Poincare hyperbolic GRU.
